note: Settings the NFL research desk follows on every scheduled run, and the defaults the page's Desk settings panel starts from. Edit here (or ask Claude to) to change what the desk looks for; the page's panel only filters what is shown on your own phone.

availability.label: Availability: official report, practice participation, beat-writer notes, starters

weather.label: Weather at kickoff: wind, gusts, rain, temperature, roof

matchup.label: Matchup: pass and run defense by EPA and success rate, pressure vs protection, tight-end coverage

cornerbacks.label: Cornerback assignments: shadow, slot vs wide

usage_form.label: Usage and form, last four games: routes, targets, carries, snap share trend, air yards

game_script.label: Game script: spread, total, pace, pass rate, expected plays

line_movement.label: Line movement: opener vs now, with or without news

situational.label: Situational: rest, travel, short week, coordinator changes, resting starters

kicker.label: Kicker form and range, field-goal try rates

stadium.label: Stadium and surface effects (altitude, turf, dome)
